entities.summary: The National Science Museum Thailand (NSM) is a state enterprise established on 30 January 1995 under the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation. NSM develops and currently operates 4 museums and 2 learning centers to raise public awareness of science for Thai society. The museums are the Science Museum, Natural History Museum, Information Technology Museum and RAMA 9 Museum. All the museums are located at Technopolis Khlong 5, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani. The NSM's learning centers are NSM Science Square @ the Street Ratchada located in Bangkok and NSM Science Square @ Chiang Mai located in Princess Siridhorn AstroPark.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The National Science Museum Thailand plays a crucial role in promoting science education and awareness among Thai society, with its four museums and two learning centers reaching over 1 million visitors annually. This initiative has contributed to the development of STEM literacy among Thai youth.
